prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. A grey winter afternoon in a 1930s schoolroom, seen from high in the back corner under the ceiling: below, the backs of grown adults in work clothes squeezed into tiny children's wooden desks, knees jammed up under the lids: a heavy-set Black baker in a vest and apron with a shaved head and a broken nose, a young South Asian mother in a headscarf, a skinny old white dock worker in a flat cap, a young Black man in overalls, a ginger woman in a factory smock, rows of them. At the front, small and off-centre, a plump teacher in her forties with round wire glasses, frizzy brown hair with a grey streak pinned in a bun and a brown cardigan stands at a big blackboard wiped clean, dark and empty, her long wooden pointer raised. Tall windows down the left wall let in cold blue-grey daylight with snow falling outside; a pot-bellied iron stove glows orange through its grille; one green-shaded lamp hangs over the teacher's desk. Worn floorboards wet from boots, puddles of melted snow, damp coats steaming on hooks. Most of the room in shadow; the brightest values are the tall windows, the stove grille and the long streaks of window light on the wet floorboards. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
